title: Puffco Pro 2 Full Top
description:
The Puffco Pro 2 Full Top (Coil & Mouthpiece) is designed to safeguard contents while simultaneously shielding the Puffco Pro 2 Coil. The threadless splash guard allows for easy cleaning and quick reload. The Puffco Pro 2 Coil is made of ceramic with a Kanthal heating element while the splash guard consists of food-safe silicone.

Included:
Puffco Pro 2 Atomizer and Mouthpiece
